positions.title: Design Thinking Lead Coach
positions.description:
- Coached 20 students through a full design thinking cycle in partnership with Circular Republic, focusing on solutions around critical raw materials.
- Facilitated problem framing, rapid prototyping, and final pitch development, guiding interdisciplinary teams from ideation to validated concepts

positions.title: Product Development
positions.description:
The joint industry project was a collaboration between MONA Motors (agricultural machinery startup) and the Center for Digital Technology and Management (CDTM).

Our four-member multidisciplinary team developed a deep-tech computer vision-based autonomy solution for compact agricultural loaders, addressing labor shortages and high manual workload in farming. My responsibilities included:
- Co-developing the business model and value proposition
- UX design, including mobile app flows
- Stakeholder coordination
- Preparing presentations and pitching (together with the team)

positions.title: Digital Product Development Analyst
positions.description:
- Worked together with my team to manage the end-to-end rebuild of the Aegean Mobile App, focusing on user stories, testing, content, and user transition.
- Worked with cross-functional teams to oversee development cycles, prioritize features, and ensure quality through QA testing and feedback.
- Researched, proposed, and planned new app features, including vendor outreach and contract negotiations.

positions.title: Founder | President
positions.description:
- Founded and led the NGO UniAI, the first Greek student initiative aimed at promoting AI education and innovation among Greek students.
- Organized seminars, workshops, intercultural experiences on AI, and the first “AI Makeathon” in Athens with over 200 participants.
- Established partnerships with companies, institutions and professionals to enhance the organization's reach and impact, through events & workshops.

company.description: At FINN our mission is to drive change for people, organizations and the planet through frictionless mobility: We help everyone who loves driving their own car but refuses the struggle, commitment and intransparent costs associated with car ownership. We achieve this by offering all-inclusive, immediately available, monthly car-subscriptions. Best thing, yet: FINN provides a more sustainable mobility option through funding climate protection projects.
